items.title: Publication rechecks only paths present in the staging snapshot or output list
items.body: Publication rechecks only paths present in the staging snapshot or output list. If another process adds a new input file under a copied tree after staging—for example, a compatibility-pack request—validation misses it and can publish generated outputs based on the older file set. This breaks the required full read-input revalidation.
items.suggestion: Under the publication lock, re-enumerate the staged input trees and compare their path sets as well as file contents before recording the transaction.
